title: Recent Payments and the Number of Settlement Installments on Deficiency Balance Accounts
content:
**Rule.** The settlement recent payments of an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts are the payments posted on the account dated fewer than 6 whole months before today, less the returned payments dated in the same period. 3 or more settlement recent payments add 2 installments to an installment settlement, at least one but fewer than 3 add 1 installment, and any smaller count adds none. Whole months are counted as the difference in calendar months between the two dates, less one when the later date's day of the month is below the earlier date's.

| Posted in the last 6 whole months | Returned in the same period | Settlement recent payments | Installments added |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | 1 | 3 | 2 |
| 3 | 1 | 2 | 1 |
| 1 | 0 | 1 | 1 |
| 1 | 1 | 0 | None |
| 0 | 0 | 0 | None |

(Hypothetical counts.)

Every posted payment counts, whatever its channel and whether or not it was made toward an arrangement; a return is taken off by its own date. Hypothetically, with today the 3rd of a month, a payment dated the 4th six months earlier is 5 whole months back and counts; one dated the 3rd six months earlier is 6 whole months back and does not.
